analysis.title: NDX Drawdown: Still Within Historical Ranges?
key_insights: US equities extended their rout with indices lower by about 200bps, and the NDX has traded below its 200d moving average for six consecutive days.
Per the desk's Figure 1, NDX spells below the 200d are typically short-lived outside of recessionary periods.
Current NDX drawdown from the 200d is about 6%, slightly more than -1 standard deviation relative to the past 20 years.
NDX drawdown from the 52-week high is about 15%.
The US 1y1y receiver from the FX Divergence piece is performing today as US rates are well-bid across the curve.
French confidence data was weak, with business confidence at 95 vs 96 estimate and 97 prior, dragged mostly by consumer confidence.
EUR has held a new range near 1.10 with limited downside pressure despite weak French data and news of a deteriorating budget.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Below estimate and prior, with the composite mostly dragged lower by consumer confidence. EUR showed limited reaction.
EUR has held its new range with limited downside pressure despite weak French data.

risk_factors: Deepening US equity drawdown if the NDX 200d breach coincides with recessionary conditions.
Deteriorating French budget and weak confidence data could pressure EUR.
